title: Replication package: Effectiveness of Generative AI in Test Case Generation: A Comparative Study with Manual Test Case Design
description:
Replication package of a controlled, paired experiment comparing JUnit 4 test suites written by human testers with suites generated by Gemini 3.8 Flash, on 12 real faults from Defects4J 3.0.1 (6 from Apache Commons Lang, 6 from Apache Commons Math). It measures fault detection, line coverage and branch coverage (JaCoCo 0.8.12).

Contents: Docker environment and every script of the pipeline, protocols, participant instructions, the AI prompt, the kits, the 24 frozen suites, mechanical review records, raw and consolidated measurements, the curation log and a complementary diagnostic. Participant data is anonymized (testers appear as T1 to T5). Code is under the MIT License; data and documentation under CC BY 4.0. See README.md, REPLICATION.md and ANONYMIZATION.md.

AL0342 Software Verification and Validation, Universidade Federal do Pampa, Squad 03, 2026.
